data.one_liner: Access ambient light sensor data on Android, iOS and macOS.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that enables applications to retrieve the current ambient light level and listen to continuous light sensor updates. It supports Android, iOS, and macOS platforms.
use_when: You need to adjust app UI brightness based on the user's environment
You want to stream continuous ambient light data
avoid_when: You need a broader sensor suite like accelerometer or gyroscope
You need to support web interface (web support is dropped)
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, and macOS
Provides both a one-time retrieval method and a continuous data stream
weaknesses: Web interface is no longer supported
Requires platform-specific configuration such as camera usage description on iOS
data.setup_notes: For iOS, you need to add the NSCameraUsageDescription key to your Info.plist file to request access to the camera for measuring ambient light.

alternatives.name: sensors_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick sensors_plus if you need standard device sensors like accelerometer, magnetometer, gyroscope, or user acceleration.
